name: setup-pkgproxy
description: GitHub Action that builds and runs pkgproxy, saving its cache at the end of the job

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run -s build:vendor && npm run -s build:action
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:vendor: esbuild src/vendor.mts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --legal-comments=external --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --minify --outfile=dist/vendor.mjs
scripts.build:action: esbuild src/main.ts src/post.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --legal-comments=external --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:#vendor --loader:.service=text --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs
